# BMAD MCP服务器
[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/bmad-mcp-server) [](LICENSE) 一个模型上下文协议服务器，它带来 [BMAD方法](https://github.com/bmad-code-org/BMAD-METHOD) AI助手。 [特性](#features) • [安装](#installation) • [用法](#usage) • [文档](#documentation)
______________________________________________________________________ ## 概述 BMAD MCP服务器为AI助手提供了11个专业代理和36个以上来自BMAD（果断构建现代应用程序）方法的自动化工作流程。配置一次，在所有项目中随处使用。 **什么是BMAD？** BMAD是一种全面的软件开发方法，具有用于不同角色（业务分析师、架构师、开发人员、用户体验设计师等）的专业AI代理和用于常见任务（PRD生成、架构设计、调试、测试）的工作流。 **为什么选择MCP？** MCP服务器提供通用访问，而不是将BMAD文件复制到每个项目： - ✅ 单一安装服务于所有项目 - ✅ 各地采用一致的方法 - ✅ 无项目混乱 - ✅ 轻松更新 ______________________________________________________________________ ## 特性 ### 统一工具架构 单 `bmad` 具有智能操作的工具： ```typescript // List available agents and workflows { operation: "list", query: "agents" } // Read agent details (no execution) { operation: "read", type: "agent", agent: "analyst" } // Execute agent with context { operation: "execute", agent: "analyst", message: "Help me..." } ``` ### 11名专业代理 |代理|角色|加载| | ---------- | ---------------- | ------------- | | 📊 玛丽|商业分析师| `analyst` | | 🏗️ Winston |系统架构师| `architect` | | 💻 Amelia |开发人员| `dev` | | 🎨 Sally |用户体验设计师| `ux-designer` | | 🧪 Murat |测试架构师| `tea` | | 📋 John |产品经理| `pm` | | 🔄 Bob | Scrum Master| `sm` | | 🐛 Diana |调试专家| `debug` | | ...|\[+3名代理\]|| ### 36+自动化工作流程 ```bash prd # Product Requirements Document architecture # System architecture design debug-inspect # Comprehensive debugging atdd # Acceptance test generation ux-design # UX specifications party-mode # Multi-agent brainstorming ... and 30+ more ``` ### MCP能力 - **工具** -统一 `bmad` 用于所有操作的工具 - **资源** -通过以下方式访问BMAD文件 `bmad://` URI - **提示词** -代理作为本地MCP提示 - **补全** -参数的智能自动补全 - **多来源** -项目、用户和Git远程支持 ______________________________________________________________________ ## 安装 ### 先决条件 - Node.js 18或更高版本 - MCP兼容客户端（Claude Desktop、VS Code with Copilot、Cline等） ### 快速开始 **选项1:npx（推荐）** 添加到MCP客户端配置中： ```json { "mcpServers": { "bmad": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "bmad-mcp-server"] } } } ``` **选项2：全局安装** ```bash npm install -g bmad-mcp-server ``` ```json { "mcpServers": { "bmad": { "command": "bmad-mcp-server" } } } ``` **方案3：地方发展** ```bash git clone https://github.com/mkellerman/bmad-mcp-server.git cd bmad-mcp-server npm install npm run build ``` ```json { "mcpServers": { "bmad": { "command": "node", "args": ["/absolute/path/to/bmad-mcp-server/build/index.js"] } } } ``` ### 客户端特定设置
Claude Desktop 编辑 `~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json` （macOS）或 `%APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json` （Windows）： ```json { "mcpServers": { "bmad": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "bmad-mcp-server"] } } } ``` 重新启动克劳德桌面。
VS Code with GitHub Copilot 1. 安装最新的GitHub Copilot扩展 1. 打开设置（JSON） 1. 添加到 `github.copilot.chat.mcp.servers`: ```json { "github.copilot.chat.mcp.servers": { "bmad": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "bmad-mcp-server"] } } } ``` 4. 重新启动VS代码
Cline (VS Code Extension) 1. 打开临床设置 1. 添加MCP服务器： ```json { "mcpServers": { "bmad": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "bmad-mcp-server"] } } } ```
______________________________________________________________________ ## 用法 ### 自然语言示例 自然地问你的人工智能助手——它会自动处理MCP工具调用： **代理执行：** ``` You: "Ask Mary to analyze the market opportunity for a SaaS product" → AI executes: { operation: "execute", agent: "analyst", message: "..." } → Mary (Business Analyst) provides market analysis ``` **工作流执行：** ``` You: "Start a PRD workflow for a task management app" → AI executes: { operation: "execute", workflow: "prd", message: "..." } → John (Product Manager) guides you through PRD creation ``` **调试协助：** ``` You: "Ask Diana to debug this script" (with code attached) → AI executes: { operation: "execute", agent: "debug", message: "..." } → Diana starts comprehensive debugging workflow ``` **协作解决问题：** ``` You: "Start party-mode with the planning team to brainstorm features" → AI executes: { operation: "execute", workflow: "party-mode", message: "..." } → Multiple agents collaborate on brainstorming session ``` **架构审查：** ``` You: "Have Winston review this system design" → AI executes: { operation: "execute", agent: "architect", message: "..." } → Winston provides architectural guidance ``` ### 直接使用MCP工具 您也可以直接使用该工具（对开发/测试有用）： **列出可用代理：** ```typescript { "operation": "list", "query": "agents" } ``` **执行代理：** ```typescript { "operation": "execute", "agent": "analyst", "message": "Help me analyze the market for a SaaS product" } ``` **运行工作流：** ```typescript { "operation": "execute", "workflow": "prd", "message": "Create PRD for task management app" } ``` **阅读代理详细信息：** ```typescript { "operation": "read", "type": "agent", "agent": "architect" } ``` ### 高级配置 **使用Git遥控器进行多源加载：** ```json { "mcpServers": { "bmad": { "command": "npx", "args": [ "-y", "bmad-mcp-server", "git+https://github.com/org/custom-bmad.git#main" ] } } } ``` **自定义项目根：** ```json { "mcpServers": { "bmad": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "bmad-mcp-server"], "env": { "BMAD_ROOT": "/custom/bmad/location" } } } } ``` ### 资源发现优先级 服务器按以下顺序搜索BMAD内容： 1. **项目本地**: `./bmad/` （最高优先级-项目自定义） 1. **用户全局**: `~/.bmad/` （个人违约） 1. **Git 远程**：克隆到 `~/.bmad/cache/git/` （共享/团队内容） 1. **软件包默认值**：内置BMAD文件（始终可用） Clone repository git clone https://github.com/mkellerman/bmad-mcp-server.git cd bmad-mcp-server # Install dependencies npm install # Build npm run build # Run tests npm test ``` ### 项目结构 ``` src/ ├── index.ts # MCP server entry point ├── cli.ts # CLI entry point ├── server.ts # MCP server implementation ├── core/ │ ├── bmad-engine.ts # Core business logic │ └── resource-loader.ts # Multi-source content loading ├── tools/ │ ├── bmad-unified.ts # Unified tool implementation │ └── operations/ # Operation handlers ├── types/ # TypeScript types └── utils/ # Utilities ``` ### npm脚本 ```bash npm run build # Compile TypeScript npm run dev # Development mode with auto-restart npm test # Run all tests npm run test:unit # Unit tests only npm run test:coverage # Coverage report npm run lint # Check linting npm run format # Format code ``` ### 测试 ```bash # Run all tests npm test # Run with coverage npm run test:coverage # Run specific test suite npm run test:unit npm run test:integration npm run test:e2e # Watch mode npm run test:watch ``` ______________________________________________________________________ ## 建筑 ### 高级概述 ``` AI Assistant (Claude, Copilot, etc.) ↓ MCP Protocol MCP Server Layer ↓ BMAD Engine (transport-agnostic) ↓ Resource Loader (multi-source) ↓ BMAD Content (agents, workflows) ``` ### 关键组件 - **服务器**：MCP协议实施（工具、资源、提示） - **引擎**：与运输无关的业务逻辑 - **加载器**：多源内容发现和加载 - **工具**：统一 `bmad` 具有模块化操作的工具 看 [架构文档](./docs/architecture.md) 了解详情。 ______________________________________________________________________ ## 贡献 我们欢迎捐款！请查看我们的 [开发指南](./docs/development-guide.md) 用于： - 开发设置 - 代码风格指南 - 测试要求 - 拉取请求流程 ### 快速贡献指南 1. 分叉存储库 1. 创建要素分支： `git checkout -b feature/my-feature` 1. 通过测试进行更改 1. 运行测试： `npm test` 1. 承诺： `git commit -m "feat: add my feature"` 1. 推： `git push origin feature/my-feature` 1. 创建拉取请求 我们使用 [常规承诺](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) 用于提交消息。 ______________________________________________________________________ ## 许可证 ISC©
